messages:
ci-bot: main build failed after merge: https://ci.internal.redwood/runs/1923456789 - job `integration/smoke-gpu` red. failing test: TestKVCacheStress.

sara: FYI pinging owners. @owen @liam any chance you can take a look? this just landed ~3m ago.

owen: on it. grabbing logs now. can someone drop the failing log lines?

liam: I saw this locally on a quick run earlier but only as a flake. looks like OOM or assert in kv cache shard.

jess: narrow snippet from the job: ```
E 2026-03-17T17:03:12Z infer_worker.cc:472] KV cache corrupt: missing entry for key 0x7fa2b3f
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
  what(): KV shard mismatch
*** Aborted at 161000000 (unix time) ***
```

owen: thanks. stacktrace points to kv cache invalidation path introduced in CL 5621 (author @jess). tagging her. @jess are you around?

jess: I wrote that change. I added a guard to drop stale shards on model swap. Haven't seen this in CI before. rolling a quick local repro now.

owen: can we try a pipeline rerun for the failing job first (non-gated) to rule out transient infra? ops-bot can you kick a rerun for job `integration/smoke-gpu` on run 1923456789?

ops-bot: rerun submitted: https://ci.internal.redwood/runs/1923456880 - job id 1923456881. queued on gpu pool. ETA ~4m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

liam: while rerun is queued, can someone bisect to narrow PR window? last merged PRs: 5618, 5621 (@jess), 5623. 5621 seems most suspicious.

sara: agree. @jess if the repro is fast can you try reverting 5621 in a local branch to see if tests pass? if that reproduces, we can open a quick revert PR.

jess: doing local revert now. if it fixes, i'll send revert PR and mark as hotfix.

own: if revert not possible immediately, we can add a quick test skip for TestKVCacheStress behind an issue flag to restore main green, then revert the skip after fix. prefer revert-first though.

sara: thanks team. please post updates here. if rerun passes we still want a root cause. if rerun fails or repro reproduces, escalate to oncall for a revert.

ops-bot: rerun finished: job 1923456881 -> FAILED (same failure).

liam: rerun failed, so likely deterministic. @jess any luck with local revert?

jess: local revert of 5621 -> tests pass for the smoke suite. i'll open revert PR now: https://git.internal.redwood/reverts/5621-revert-kv-guard - pinging @sara for approval.

sara: thanks. please include test that reproduces the failure in the revert PR so we don't regrow this. add a note in the rollback to run full gpu smoke.

nowen: i'll take ownership of follow-up to root cause after revert lands. assigning myself and adding to my board.

sara: perfect. tagging this thread resolved once revert merges. great quick triage, all. :thumbsup:
